response.description: AI model management in Azure HorizonDB is now in limited preview, designed to simplify how you bring AI into your database. With just a single step, you can provision fully managed AI models for embeddings, semantic ranking, and generation through Microsoft Foundry, without having to manage endpoints, credentials, or cross-service configuration.  This integrated experience removes the need for manual setup and context switching, allowing you to use built-in AI functions directly within PostgreSQL and immediately start building AI-powered applications. You also gain a unified environment where model provisioning, management, monitoring, and billing are handled seamlessly within Azure HorizonDB, helping you stay focused on your application logic instead of infrastructure complexity. The same in-database experience extends to existing models you've already deployed in Microsoft Foundry, streamlining registration while providing full integration with AI functions. To request access, complete the AI Model Management limited preview participation form. Learn more.
response.title: Limited Preview: AI model management in Azure HorizonDB
